name: Fisherman
uniques: Never appears as a Barbarian unit <hidden from users>
Triggers a [Go Fishing] event <upon ending a turn in a [Trout] tile>
Triggers a [Go Fishing] event <upon ending a turn in a [Northern Pike] tile>

civilopediaText.text: A [Fisherman] can go fishing on a [Trout] or [Northern Pike] tile outside the city limits which will consume the [Fisherman]
A [Fisherman] with the [Fisher] promotion allows cities to construct [Fish Market]s once [Currency] is discovered.
A [Fisherman] with the [Angler] promotion allows cities to construct [Fishery]s once [Guilds] is discovered
A [Fisherman] with the [Troller] promotion allows a city to construct [Fisherman's Wharf] wonder in a city with a [Harbor] once [Compass] is discovered.
One can always choose to sell the fish for [Gold].
